thread:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync for tomorrow's "Live Tuning Lab" 4:00 PT. We need final owners for: confirmation email copy, local backup, transcript flow, HubSpot tag mapping, social clip handoff. Trying to keep this <10 lines so greenroom can focus.

Rui (Events): I'll own greenroom + local backup. Local OBS record + cloud recording. I'll enable auto-transcript but request a clean speaker list for caption alignment.

Sana (Ops): Zoom-bot: confirm cloud recording webhook and S3 path. Also, do we want auto-clip extraction by timestamp markers?

zoom-bot: Cloud recording active. Webhook target /hooks/recording-upload configured. S3 target: s3://redwood-marketing/live-lab/2026-06-15/. Recording retention: 90 days.

Asha (Content): I'll do highlight edit + 3 short clips (60s, 45s, 30s). Need raw mp4 + srt. Prefer filenames: 20260615_live-tuning_master.mp4 and 20260615_live-tuning_transcript.srt

Diego (Growth): I'll take social-ready versions and captions. Also want an attendee property in HubSpot: attended=true/false and tag: "live-tuning-2026". If company domain contains "trialco" mark is_trial=true so AE can follow up.

Maya (Marketing): Reg confirmation copy draft: "You're registered! Add to calendar 1. Join live: <zoom link>. We'll send the replay, slides, and highlights within 48 hours." Keep it concise. Also add a CTA to submit a single prep question (optional).

Rui (Events): Greenroom checklist: slides exported as PDF + speaker bios in Zoom name, host spotlight tested, mic check 5 mins early. I'll join 40m early.

Sana (Ops): Implementing HubSpot webhook payload will include: s3_mp4, s3_srt, replay_url_ttl_days=14, company_domain, is_trial. Also adding field: "auto_clip_markers": true so post-process can slice at slide changes.

Asha (Content): If "auto_clip_markers" works, editors will still curate. Requesting the raw markers csv in the webhook so I can pick timestamps.

Sana (Ops): Noted. Webhook will attach markers.csv URL when available.

Diego (Growth): For the replay email flow: attended -> immediate replay + survey link; registered-no-show -> 3-step drip over 7 days. Include micro-survey (1 Q) to gate longer assets.

Maya (Marketing): Legal: TTL 14 days for public replay link pending your OK. Looping legal now.

Rui (Events): One small ask 5: can we disable join before host? prefer yes so attendees wait in lobby if host delayed. Thoughts?

Maya (Marketing): Let's keep join before host OFF per events ask.

Sana (Ops): Implemented: join_before_host=false. Webhook will include echo of final settings.

Asha (Content): Recap of owners: Rui = greenroom + local backup, Sana = upload + webhook + markers, Asha = editing + highlights, Diego = distribution + tags, Maya = confirmation + replay copy.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll drop the confirmation template into /assets/email-templates/ and ping #marketing when done. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
